text.en: Clients frequently commend team members including Alex, Cadence, and Brittany for their approachable manners and attentive customer care. Pet owners highlight that staff answer telephone enquiries promptly, listen carefully to specific styling instructions, and create a welcoming parlour atmosphere. Multiple reviewers express loyalty to individual stylists who show genuine enthusiasm for companion animals.

title.en: Skilful styling with occasional clipping flaws

text.en: Most pet owners report excellent styling outcomes for haircuts, nail trims, and feline lion cuts, noting that pets emerge looking tidy and fresh. Reviewers frequently praise the scissor finish on doodles and maltese dogs. However, one client noted uneven cutting and skin irritation on a small dog following a groom, though general feedback reflects dependable grooming workmanship.

title.en: Patient handling for dogs and cats

text.en: Pet parents appreciate the gentle handling extended to senior dogs, nervous rescues, and long-haired cats during parlour sessions. Reviewers note that groomers remain calm with pets that feel intimidated by new environments or unfamiliar equipment. Several clients mention that their animals show no signs of distress and return home relaxed after baths and fur trims.

q.en: Do groomers at One Love Pet Parlor cater to cats?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that stylists groom long-haired cats, including specialised styling such as lion cuts.

q.en: Are quick services like nail trimming offered without long delays?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that nail trims for companion dogs are completed efficiently in around ten minutes.

q.en: How are grooming appointments scheduled at this salon?

a.en: Appointments are scheduled by telephone and direct contact with parlour staff on East Shea Boulevard.

q.en: Can large or elderly dogs be accommodated?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report that staff handle large breeds and older dogs with cautious, supportive care.
